meta.title: Gravitic Resistance
meta.description: Her feelings and obligations are tearing her apart. A faint hint of bitterness spreads through the night.

units.rawText: On the planet's surface, a few Entropized Agents patrol around on set tracks.
units.displayText: On the planet's surface, a few Entropized Agents patrol around on set tracks.

spans.text: On the planet's surface, a few Entropized Agents patrol around on set tracks.

units.rawText: Guard... space station...
units.displayText: Guard... space station...

spans.text: Guard... space station...

units.rawText: Guard... data...
units.displayText: Guard... data...

spans.text: Guard... data...

units.rawText: Professor, we've successfully landed! The soil here is a little soft, we...
units.displayText: Professor, we've successfully landed! The soil here is a little soft, we...

spans.text: Professor, we've successfully landed! The soil here is a little soft, we...

units.rawText: Wait, why can we still hear sound?
units.displayText: Wait, why can we still hear sound?

spans.text: Wait, why can we still hear sound?

units.rawText: There is thin air on the surface of each and every planet... in imitation of the Earth?
units.displayText: There is thin air on the surface of each and every planet... in imitation of the Earth?

spans.text: There is thin air on the surface of each and every planet... in imitation of the Earth?

units.rawText: One can only hear their own singing while stargazing if that is the case, no? Hehe...
units.displayText: One can only hear their own singing while stargazing if that is the case, no? Hehe...

spans.text: One can only hear their own singing while stargazing if that is the case, no? Hehe...

units.rawText: This place is built with more rigor than expected.
units.displayText: This place is built with more rigor than expected.

spans.text: This place is built with more rigor than expected.

units.rawText: Ahead of us... Xuannu, are those the Agents we're looking for?
units.displayText: Ahead of us... Xuannu, are those the Agents we're looking for?

spans.text: Ahead of us... Xuannu, are those the Agents we're looking for?

units.rawText: Yes.
units.displayText: Yes.

spans.text: Yes.

units.rawText: But why are they... seemingly to be guarding Hubble's data?
units.displayText: But why are they... seemingly to be guarding Hubble's data?

spans.text: But why are they... seemingly to be guarding Hubble's data?

units.rawText: I suspect... it's because that Entropized Agents who originally possessed permissions tend to be entangled with special data fragments.
units.displayText: I suspect... it's because that Entropized Agents who originally possessed permissions tend to be entangled with special data fragments.

spans.text: I suspect... it's because that Entropized Agents who originally possessed permissions tend to be entangled with special data fragments.

units.rawText: The very final commands they received ought to have been to protect important data.
units.displayText: The very final commands they received ought to have been to protect important data.

spans.text: The very final commands they received ought to have been to protect important data.

units.rawText: These agents are still executing their orders, but... in their Entropized state, they cannot distinguish what this data exactly is.
units.displayText: These agents are still executing their orders, but... in their Entropized state, they cannot distinguish what this data exactly is.

spans.text: These agents are still executing their orders, but... in their Entropized state, they cannot distinguish what this data exactly is.

units.rawText: Still in a state of bewilderment? Unexpectedly adorable.
units.displayText: Still in a state of bewilderment? Unexpectedly adorable.

spans.text: Still in a state of bewilderment? Unexpectedly adorable.

units.rawText: This degree of Entropization... Xuannu, any chance they can still be retrieved?
units.displayText: This degree of Entropization... Xuannu, any chance they can still be retrieved?

spans.text: This degree of Entropization... Xuannu, any chance they can still be retrieved?

units.rawText: ...It's too late. Two of them are special models, and the space station they were responsible for is still in an inactive state.
units.displayText: ...It's too late. Two of them are special models, and the space station they were responsible for is still in an inactive state.

spans.text: ...It's too late. Two of them are special models, and the space station they were responsible for is still in an inactive state.

units.rawText: Space station!
units.displayText: Space station!

spans.text: Space station!

units.rawText: Space station... space station!
units.displayText: Space station... space station!

spans.text: Space station... space station!

units.rawText: As if latching onto a keyword, the previously idly meandering Agents all turn to look.
units.displayText: As if latching onto a keyword, the previously idly meandering Agents all turn to look.

spans.text: As if latching onto a keyword, the previously idly meandering Agents all turn to look.

units.rawText: Not knowing that their "space station" is long gone and that the world's reset button was hit long ago, these Agents still faithfully carry out their duties—their Entropized selves still live in a Sector not yet reset.
units.displayText: Not knowing that their "space station" is long gone and that the world's reset button was hit long ago, these Agents still faithfully carry out their duties—their Entropized selves still live in a Sector not yet reset.

spans.text: Not knowing that their "space station" is long gone and that the world's reset button was hit long ago, these Agents still faithfully carry out their duties—their Entropized selves still live in a Sector not yet reset.

units.rawText: Just like Hubble and this Starsphere, they are frozen in the instant mass was neutralized.
units.displayText: Just like Hubble and this Starsphere, they are frozen in the instant mass was neutralized.

spans.text: Just like Hubble and this Starsphere, they are frozen in the instant mass was neutralized.

units.rawText: This Entropization... no, none of that means anything now.
units.displayText: This Entropization... no, none of that means anything now.

spans.text: This Entropization... no, none of that means anything now.

units.rawText: I saw them when we came across one of the space stations...
units.displayText: I saw them when we came across one of the space stations...

spans.text: I saw them when we came across one of the space stations...

units.rawText: ...Will we really have to "deal with" all of them?
units.displayText: ...Will we really have to "deal with" all of them?

spans.text: ...Will we really have to "deal with" all of them?

units.rawText: The moment Entropization sets in, there is no turning back.
units.displayText: The moment Entropization sets in, there is no turning back.

spans.text: The moment Entropization sets in, there is no turning back.

units.rawText: These things are decided by their neural structure, Fresnel. It fills me with regrets as well, but... we must play our roles.
units.displayText: These things are decided by their neural structure, Fresnel. It fills me with regrets as well, but... we must play our roles.

spans.text: These things are decided by their neural structure, Fresnel. It fills me with regrets as well, but... we must play our roles.

units.rawText: Role... role... defend space station...
units.displayText: Role... role... defend space station...

spans.text: Role... role... defend space station...

units.rawText: Repel... invaders...
units.displayText: Repel... invaders...

spans.text: Repel... invaders...

units.rawText: Repel invaders!
units.displayText: Repel invaders!

spans.text: Repel invaders!

units.rawText: The Agents seem to have come to some collective agreement. Rather, they are driven by instincts instilled in them by Entropization, turning the desire to protect into belligerence and hostility. They find a new "enemy", closing in on Fresnel and Hubble.
units.displayText: The Agents seem to have come to some collective agreement. Rather, they are driven by instincts instilled in them by Entropization, turning the desire to protect into belligerence and hostility. They find a new "enemy", closing in on Fresnel and Hubble.

spans.text: The Agents seem to have come to some collective agreement. Rather, they are driven by instincts instilled in them by Entropization, turning the desire to protect into belligerence and hostility. They find a new "enemy", closing in on Fresnel and Hubble.

units.rawText: ...So this is how it has to go. Looks like we have to—Professor, please command us!
units.displayText: ...So this is how it has to go. Looks like we have to—Professor, please command us!

spans.text: ...So this is how it has to go. Looks like we have to—Professor, please command us!

units.rawText: I'm here.
units.displayText: I'm here.

spans.text: I'm here.

units.rawText: Battle is upon us in the blink of an eye. Hubble only floats off to the side, lazily pursing her lips.
units.displayText: Battle is upon us in the blink of an eye. Hubble only floats off to the side, lazily pursing her lips.

spans.text: Battle is upon us in the blink of an eye. Hubble only floats off to the side, lazily pursing her lips.

units.rawText: Yawn.
units.displayText: Yawn.

spans.text: Yawn.

units.rawText: Drifting star-crumbs are always exceptionally charming. Even if they are occasionally hindrances... easily pushed to the side when the time comes, though.
units.displayText: Drifting star-crumbs are always exceptionally charming. Even if they are occasionally hindrances... easily pushed to the side when the time comes, though.

spans.text: Drifting star-crumbs are always exceptionally charming. Even if they are occasionally hindrances... easily pushed to the side when the time comes, though.

units.rawText: So, shall we clear out this scrap first?
units.displayText: So, shall we clear out this scrap first?

spans.text: So, shall we clear out this scrap first?

units.rawText: Yes. Shall we do it together, Hubble?
units.displayText: Yes. Shall we do it together, Hubble?

spans.text: Yes. Shall we do it together, Hubble?

units.rawText: Together?
units.displayText: Together?

spans.text: Together?

units.rawText: Just like before.
units.displayText: Just like before.

spans.text: Just like before.

units.rawText: Regrettably, I do not recall that either. However...
units.displayText: Regrettably, I do not recall that either. However...

spans.text: Regrettably, I do not recall that either. However...

units.rawText: Hubble nonchalantly raises a hand, her telescope unfurling and turning towards the approaching Entropized Agents—
units.displayText: Hubble nonchalantly raises a hand, her telescope unfurling and turning towards the approaching Entropized Agents—

spans.text: Hubble nonchalantly raises a hand, her telescope unfurling and turning towards the approaching Entropized Agents—

units.rawText: In but a moment, peculiar light bursts forth from the planet's surface. As starlight spirals and swings, the meandering agents transform into glowing shards.
units.displayText: In but a moment, peculiar light bursts forth from the planet's surface. As starlight spirals and swings, the meandering agents transform into glowing shards.

spans.text: In but a moment, peculiar light bursts forth from the planet's surface. As starlight spirals and swings, the meandering agents transform into glowing shards.

units.rawText: Jiutian... glory!
units.displayText: Jiutian... glory!

spans.text: Jiutian... glory!

units.rawText: As if they were defending Jiutian, even as their compatriots fall one by one, the remaining agents charge toward Hubble without any hesitation, activating their self-destruct sequences.
units.displayText: As if they were defending Jiutian, even as their compatriots fall one by one, the remaining agents charge toward Hubble without any hesitation, activating their self-destruct sequences.

spans.text: As if they were defending Jiutian, even as their compatriots fall one by one, the remaining agents charge toward Hubble without any hesitation, activating their self-destruct sequences.

units.rawText: Explosions flare up, only to be pushed backward by resurgent air.
units.displayText: Explosions flare up, only to be pushed backward by resurgent air.

spans.text: Explosions flare up, only to be pushed backward by resurgent air.

units.rawText: That'll do, right?
units.displayText: That'll do, right?

spans.text: That'll do, right?

units.rawText: Without warning, the battle was at an end. The shattered Entropized Agents slowly disappear on the planet's surface, just like the star-crumbs Hubble spoke of.
units.displayText: Without warning, the battle was at an end. The shattered Entropized Agents slowly disappear on the planet's surface, just like the star-crumbs Hubble spoke of.

spans.text: Without warning, the battle was at an end. The shattered Entropized Agents slowly disappear on the planet's surface, just like the star-crumbs Hubble spoke of.

units.rawText: So that's... star-crumbs...
units.displayText: So that's... star-crumbs...

spans.text: So that's... star-crumbs...

units.rawText: Still carrying out their orders, even after Entropization...
units.displayText: Still carrying out their orders, even after Entropization...

spans.text: Still carrying out their orders, even after Entropization...

units.rawText: Beautiful, no? Or is such an abrupt end to things not to your taste?
units.displayText: Beautiful, no? Or is such an abrupt end to things not to your taste?

spans.text: Beautiful, no? Or is such an abrupt end to things not to your taste?

units.rawText: No... it is beautiful. Till everything is at its end.
units.displayText: No... it is beautiful. Till everything is at its end.

spans.text: No... it is beautiful. Till everything is at its end.

units.rawText: Fresnel is still a little absentminded with matters coming to an end so quickly.
units.displayText: Fresnel is still a little absentminded with matters coming to an end so quickly.

spans.text: Fresnel is still a little absentminded with matters coming to an end so quickly.

units.rawText: I just... can't quite bring myself to do it, Hubble. Work is one thing, and emotions are another.
units.displayText: I just... can't quite bring myself to do it, Hubble. Work is one thing, and emotions are another.

spans.text: I just... can't quite bring myself to do it, Hubble. Work is one thing, and emotions are another.

units.rawText: After all, they hung on until the very end for Jiutian. These are things we have all seen.
units.displayText: After all, they hung on until the very end for Jiutian. These are things we have all seen.

spans.text: After all, they hung on until the very end for Jiutian. These are things we have all seen.

units.rawText: Even if I understand our responsibilities on this journey... but if we have you here, maybe they...
units.displayText: Even if I understand our responsibilities on this journey... but if we have you here, maybe they...

spans.text: Even if I understand our responsibilities on this journey... but if we have you here, maybe they...

units.rawText: They?
units.displayText: They?

spans.text: They?

units.rawText: Hubble is clearly confounded. She fidgets with starlight between her fingertips, projecting it towards Fresnel's hair.
units.displayText: Hubble is clearly confounded. She fidgets with starlight between her fingertips, projecting it towards Fresnel's hair.

spans.text: Hubble is clearly confounded. She fidgets with starlight between her fingertips, projecting it towards Fresnel's hair.

units.rawText: I do not understand... is this not what you came here for?
units.displayText: I do not understand... is this not what you came here for?

spans.text: I do not understand... is this not what you came here for?

units.rawText: Why is it that you reach the star's very being, but only become more distressed?
units.displayText: Why is it that you reach the star's very being, but only become more distressed?

spans.text: Why is it that you reach the star's very being, but only become more distressed?

units.rawText: Fresnel cannot muster up a response in the moment. The Entropized agents' figures fade as she instinctively walks forward, removing the upper parts of the scrap heap with a light touch.
units.displayText: Fresnel cannot muster up a response in the moment. The Entropized agents' figures fade as she instinctively walks forward, removing the upper parts of the scrap heap with a light touch.

spans.text: Fresnel cannot muster up a response in the moment. The Entropized agents' figures fade as she instinctively walks forward, removing the upper parts of the scrap heap with a light touch.

units.rawText: A warm light is nestled beneath, bits and pieces of ambient light connecting it with Hubble.
units.displayText: A warm light is nestled beneath, bits and pieces of ambient light connecting it with Hubble.

spans.text: A warm light is nestled beneath, bits and pieces of ambient light connecting it with Hubble.

units.rawText: Think we've found it. Is that it?
units.displayText: Think we've found it. Is that it?

spans.text: Think we've found it. Is that it?

units.rawText: Let me have a look at the instruments... yeah, that's it. We don't know which part it is exactly, but it is without doubt Hubble's memories.
units.displayText: Let me have a look at the instruments... yeah, that's it. We don't know which part it is exactly, but it is without doubt Hubble's memories.

spans.text: Let me have a look at the instruments... yeah, that's it. We don't know which part it is exactly, but it is without doubt Hubble's memories.

units.rawText: Thank goodness this fragment hasn't been Entropized yet. Though this is pretty short...
units.displayText: Thank goodness this fragment hasn't been Entropized yet. Though this is pretty short...

spans.text: Thank goodness this fragment hasn't been Entropized yet. Though this is pretty short...

units.rawText: There's too little information to cross-check. Hubble, try to absorb it. I'll be keeping an eye on things live.
units.displayText: There's too little information to cross-check. Hubble, try to absorb it. I'll be keeping an eye on things live.

spans.text: There's too little information to cross-check. Hubble, try to absorb it. I'll be keeping an eye on things live.

units.rawText: Hubble approaches the orb of light curiously, and it slides into her body as if fusing with her. As data flows inward, images seem to flash up in succession against a backdrop of dim light.
units.displayText: Hubble approaches the orb of light curiously, and it slides into her body as if fusing with her. As data flows inward, images seem to flash up in succession against a backdrop of dim light.

spans.text: Hubble approaches the orb of light curiously, and it slides into her body as if fusing with her. As data flows inward, images seem to flash up in succession against a backdrop of dim light.

units.rawText: This is... when the Oasis was invaded?
units.displayText: This is... when the Oasis was invaded?

spans.text: This is... when the Oasis was invaded?

units.rawText: Fight them if you have to, but cherish your dogs! They're innocent!
units.displayText: Fight them if you have to, but cherish your dogs! They're innocent!

spans.text: Fight them if you have to, but cherish your dogs! They're innocent!

units.rawText: No, bring them along. I hate dogs!
units.displayText: No, bring them along. I hate dogs!

spans.text: No, bring them along. I hate dogs!

units.rawText: Hehe, don't argue. Everyone, please follow the shooting star as you fall back—
units.displayText: Hehe, don't argue. Everyone, please follow the shooting star as you fall back—

spans.text: Hehe, don't argue. Everyone, please follow the shooting star as you fall back—

units.rawText: A lost part of... me? I think I recognize...
units.displayText: A lost part of... me? I think I recognize...

spans.text: A lost part of... me? I think I recognize...

units.rawText: Looks like the memory data took concrete form. If even such a short segment of data can be materialized, then the complete stretch of data ought to be clearer.
units.displayText: Looks like the memory data took concrete form. If even such a short segment of data can be materialized, then the complete stretch of data ought to be clearer.

spans.text: Looks like the memory data took concrete form. If even such a short segment of data can be materialized, then the complete stretch of data ought to be clearer.

units.rawText: Gah...
units.displayText: Gah...

spans.text: Gah...

units.rawText: My head... hurts a bit...
units.displayText: My head... hurts a bit...

spans.text: My head... hurts a bit...

units.rawText: Hubble? Does this data affect you in any way?
units.displayText: Hubble? Does this data affect you in any way?

spans.text: Hubble? Does this data affect you in any way?

units.rawText: ...Ah, it seems temporary.
units.displayText: ...Ah, it seems temporary.

spans.text: ...Ah, it seems temporary.

units.rawText: Hubble blinks repeatedly, returning to normal soon.
units.displayText: Hubble blinks repeatedly, returning to normal soon.

spans.text: Hubble blinks repeatedly, returning to normal soon.

units.rawText: It's but a shred of stardust, but there certainly is something there...
units.displayText: It's but a shred of stardust, but there certainly is something there...

spans.text: It's but a shred of stardust, but there certainly is something there...

units.rawText: So long as you're fine... it would not be worth burdening your body.
units.displayText: So long as you're fine... it would not be worth burdening your body.

spans.text: So long as you're fine... it would not be worth burdening your body.

units.rawText: In any case, we have two pieces of news.
units.displayText: In any case, we have two pieces of news.

spans.text: In any case, we have two pieces of news.

units.rawText: The good news is that with this piece of data for comparison, the Analysis System will be able to verify data integrity much faster, and we'll be able to work efficiently from now on.
units.displayText: The good news is that with this piece of data for comparison, the Analysis System will be able to verify data integrity much faster, and we'll be able to work efficiently from now on.

spans.text: The good news is that with this piece of data for comparison, the Analysis System will be able to verify data integrity much faster, and we'll be able to work efficiently from now on.

units.rawText: Sounds like there's some bad news waiting for us.
units.displayText: Sounds like there's some bad news waiting for us.

spans.text: Sounds like there's some bad news waiting for us.

units.rawText: ...The bad news is that we must move as fast as possible from now on and prioritize more complete pieces of data.
units.displayText: ...The bad news is that we must move as fast as possible from now on and prioritize more complete pieces of data.

spans.text: ...The bad news is that we must move as fast as possible from now on and prioritize more complete pieces of data.

units.rawText: Just then, the rate at which this Starsphere is Entropizing increased... and the scattered Entropized Agents are likely to become stronger as well.
units.displayText: Just then, the rate at which this Starsphere is Entropizing increased... and the scattered Entropized Agents are likely to become stronger as well.

spans.text: Just then, the rate at which this Starsphere is Entropizing increased... and the scattered Entropized Agents are likely to become stronger as well.

units.rawText: If things continue, I worry that... Hubble's remaining memory data will be Entropized and desynthesized too.
units.displayText: If things continue, I worry that... Hubble's remaining memory data will be Entropized and desynthesized too.

spans.text: If things continue, I worry that... Hubble's remaining memory data will be Entropized and desynthesized too.

units.rawText: What...
units.displayText: What...

spans.text: What...

units.rawText: The Heat Death Program Entropizes a planet from the inside out, and we cannot directly observe which planets are silently changing...
units.displayText: The Heat Death Program Entropizes a planet from the inside out, and we cannot directly observe which planets are silently changing...

spans.text: The Heat Death Program Entropizes a planet from the inside out, and we cannot directly observe which planets are silently changing...

units.rawText: By the time we receive a signal, the transformation is always already in progress—sometimes even finished.
units.displayText: By the time we receive a signal, the transformation is always already in progress—sometimes even finished.

spans.text: By the time we receive a signal, the transformation is always already in progress—sometimes even finished.

units.rawText: So that's what caused Jiutian to be thrown into jeopardy...
units.displayText: So that's what caused Jiutian to be thrown into jeopardy...

spans.text: So that's what caused Jiutian to be thrown into jeopardy...

units.rawText: This Starsphere is even more dangerous than expected. Please, be cautious.
units.displayText: This Starsphere is even more dangerous than expected. Please, be cautious.

spans.text: This Starsphere is even more dangerous than expected. Please, be cautious.

units.rawText: I'm worried that by the time you find a part of the data, it'll be too far gone.
units.displayText: I'm worried that by the time you find a part of the data, it'll be too far gone.

spans.text: I'm worried that by the time you find a part of the data, it'll be too far gone.

units.rawText: Antonina unravels an information panel, informing us that the Starsphere's inner regions were changing at unimaginable rates.
units.displayText: Antonina unravels an information panel, informing us that the Starsphere's inner regions were changing at unimaginable rates.

spans.text: Antonina unravels an information panel, informing us that the Starsphere's inner regions were changing at unimaginable rates.

units.rawText: This speed of Entropization...
units.displayText: This speed of Entropization...

spans.text: This speed of Entropization...

units.rawText: Hubble, we're running out of time, we need to leave right now!
units.displayText: Hubble, we're running out of time, we need to leave right now!

spans.text: Hubble, we're running out of time, we need to leave right now!

units.rawText: Hm? Why are we in such a rush?
units.displayText: Hm? Why are we in such a rush?

spans.text: Hm? Why are we in such a rush?

units.rawText: Is Entropization... not a good thing?
units.displayText: Is Entropization... not a good thing?

spans.text: Is Entropization... not a good thing?

units.rawText: There might be obstructive star-crumbs that must be removed, but if I was never Entropized, I would never be able to do all of this, no?
units.displayText: There might be obstructive star-crumbs that must be removed, but if I was never Entropized, I would never be able to do all of this, no?

spans.text: There might be obstructive star-crumbs that must be removed, but if I was never Entropized, I would never be able to do all of this, no?

units.rawText: We cannot allow your Entropization to continue, Hubble.
units.displayText: We cannot allow your Entropization to continue, Hubble.

spans.text: We cannot allow your Entropization to continue, Hubble.

units.rawText: That road is not one that can be controlled... if you stray too far, we'll lose you for good.
units.displayText: That road is not one that can be controlled... if you stray too far, we'll lose you for good.

spans.text: That road is not one that can be controlled... if you stray too far, we'll lose you for good.

units.rawText: Fresnel, Entropization was always a most delightful, eternal affair... just that you cannot yet experience it.
units.displayText: Fresnel, Entropization was always a most delightful, eternal affair... just that you cannot yet experience it.

spans.text: Fresnel, Entropization was always a most delightful, eternal affair... just that you cannot yet experience it.

units.rawText: What I can see now is no less than a new world.
units.displayText: What I can see now is no less than a new world.

spans.text: What I can see now is no less than a new world.

units.rawText: Ever so hostile towards Entropization, but always so cordial towards an Entropized me...
units.displayText: Ever so hostile towards Entropization, but always so cordial towards an Entropized me...

spans.text: Ever so hostile towards Entropization, but always so cordial towards an Entropized me...

units.rawText: Your thoughts are as difficult to fathom as a boundless chart of stars.
units.displayText: Your thoughts are as difficult to fathom as a boundless chart of stars.

spans.text: Your thoughts are as difficult to fathom as a boundless chart of stars.

units.rawText: In your eyes, just what is the difference between me and those Entropics bound for destruction?
units.displayText: In your eyes, just what is the difference between me and those Entropics bound for destruction?

spans.text: In your eyes, just what is the difference between me and those Entropics bound for destruction?

units.rawText: ...I don't see you that way.
units.displayText: ...I don't see you that way.

spans.text: ...I don't see you that way.

units.rawText: The air grows heavy. I interject.
units.displayText: The air grows heavy. I interject.

spans.text: The air grows heavy. I interject.

options.rawText: We can find the answer together.
options.displayText: We can find the answer together.

spans.text: We can find the answer together.
You're not the same.

units.rawText: We do not need to come up with an answer now, Hubble.
units.displayText: We do not need to come up with an answer now, Hubble.

spans.text: We do not need to come up with an answer now, Hubble.

units.rawText: To Fresnel, to me, to the entirety of the Oasis—you're important.
units.displayText: To Fresnel, to me, to the entirety of the Oasis—you're important.

spans.text: To Fresnel, to me, to the entirety of the Oasis—you're important.

units.rawText: Not every problem can be immediately solved in a way that is pleasing to everyone. But at least with your quandary, this little guy's existence is enough to answer some of it.
units.displayText: Not every problem can be immediately solved in a way that is pleasing to everyone. But at least with your quandary, this little guy's existence is enough to answer some of it.

spans.text: Not every problem can be immediately solved in a way that is pleasing to everyone. But at least with your quandary, this little guy's existence is enough to answer some of it.

units.rawText: Squeak?
units.displayText: Squeak?

spans.text: Squeak?

units.rawText: It is precisely because you are different from those Entropics that Fresnel cares so much. I'm the same way.
units.displayText: It is precisely because you are different from those Entropics that Fresnel cares so much. I'm the same way.

spans.text: It is precisely because you are different from those Entropics that Fresnel cares so much. I'm the same way.

units.rawText: Hm... you don't agree, Professor?
units.displayText: Hm... you don't agree, Professor?

spans.text: Hm... you don't agree, Professor?

units.rawText: What draws the line between "Entropic" and "friend"? Ever since I met you, I've been contemplating this question.
units.displayText: What draws the line between "Entropic" and "friend"? Ever since I met you, I've been contemplating this question.

spans.text: What draws the line between "Entropic" and "friend"? Ever since I met you, I've been contemplating this question.

units.rawText: But at least... when dealing with "you", we'll always be your friends.
units.displayText: But at least... when dealing with "you", we'll always be your friends.

spans.text: But at least... when dealing with "you", we'll always be your friends.

units.rawText: I know you have doubts, but we can slowly seek those answers together.
units.displayText: I know you have doubts, but we can slowly seek those answers together.

spans.text: I know you have doubts, but we can slowly seek those answers together.

units.rawText: While we are in that process, I would ask you to contemplate our emotions well.
units.displayText: While we are in that process, I would ask you to contemplate our emotions well.

spans.text: While we are in that process, I would ask you to contemplate our emotions well.

units.rawText: Ah... how dazzling. I must be feeling the gravity of a star...
units.displayText: Ah... how dazzling. I must be feeling the gravity of a star...

spans.text: Ah... how dazzling. I must be feeling the gravity of a star...

units.rawText: Professor, you truly are hefty.
units.displayText: Professor, you truly are hefty.

spans.text: Professor, you truly are hefty.

units.rawText: Hefty?
units.displayText: Hefty?

spans.text: Hefty?

units.rawText: Gravity is determined by mass. A Professor that has a very special pull must have stunning mass, too.
units.displayText: Gravity is determined by mass. A Professor that has a very special pull must have stunning mass, too.

spans.text: Gravity is determined by mass. A Professor that has a very special pull must have stunning mass, too.

units.rawText: With gravity like an alien star... Professor, you must have an instant where you incline towards collapse, too, right?
units.displayText: With gravity like an alien star... Professor, you must have an instant where you incline towards collapse, too, right?

spans.text: With gravity like an alien star... Professor, you must have an instant where you incline towards collapse, too, right?

units.rawText: ...But, as Professor says, we can take it slow.
units.displayText: ...But, as Professor says, we can take it slow.

spans.text: ...But, as Professor says, we can take it slow.

units.rawText: Hubble turns around, lightly caressing Fresnel's hair, flicking the stardust embedded in her hair into the air.
units.displayText: Hubble turns around, lightly caressing Fresnel's hair, flicking the stardust embedded in her hair into the air.

spans.text: Hubble turns around, lightly caressing Fresnel's hair, flicking the stardust embedded in her hair into the air.

units.rawText: Every star must meet its end eventually, after all. The same goes for this one...
units.displayText: Every star must meet its end eventually, after all. The same goes for this one...

spans.text: Every star must meet its end eventually, after all. The same goes for this one...

units.rawText: Are you still sad?
units.displayText: Are you still sad?

spans.text: Are you still sad?

units.rawText: I'm sorry, Hubble.
units.displayText: I'm sorry, Hubble.

spans.text: I'm sorry, Hubble.

units.rawText: Hehe, looks like "I" really hit you hard... in what remains of my memories, you don't seem like that sort of person.
units.displayText: Hehe, looks like "I" really hit you hard... in what remains of my memories, you don't seem like that sort of person.

spans.text: Hehe, looks like "I" really hit you hard... in what remains of my memories, you don't seem like that sort of person.

units.rawText: I'm not sure why, but I'd rather not see you in such poor spirits... is there anything I can do to make you happy?
units.displayText: I'm not sure why, but I'd rather not see you in such poor spirits... is there anything I can do to make you happy?

spans.text: I'm not sure why, but I'd rather not see you in such poor spirits... is there anything I can do to make you happy?

units.rawText: I ought to have been the one doing that for you. But... I must have messed up.
units.displayText: I ought to have been the one doing that for you. But... I must have messed up.

spans.text: I ought to have been the one doing that for you. But... I must have messed up.

units.rawText: What does that matter? Let me think...
units.displayText: What does that matter? Let me think...

spans.text: What does that matter? Let me think...

units.rawText: How about we continue our scavenger hunt? Track down those pieces of "important data" like you originally hoped.
units.displayText: How about we continue our scavenger hunt? Track down those pieces of "important data" like you originally hoped.

spans.text: How about we continue our scavenger hunt? Track down those pieces of "important data" like you originally hoped.

units.rawText: If memories tend to float and meander like the subconscious does, I would wager... that they're gathered around astronomical marvels.
units.displayText: If memories tend to float and meander like the subconscious does, I would wager... that they're gathered around astronomical marvels.

spans.text: If memories tend to float and meander like the subconscious does, I would wager... that they're gathered around astronomical marvels.

units.rawText: Fresnel raises her head, finding Hubble's smiling face in her view. On the vast canvas behind her, a comet flickers in the faraway distance.
units.displayText: Fresnel raises her head, finding Hubble's smiling face in her view. On the vast canvas behind her, a comet flickers in the faraway distance.
